method.label: Find ties, then use color symmetry

annotationRationale: Independence gives each same-bin probability, a convergent geometric series sums the mutually exclusive tie events, and complementation followed by color symmetry gives the requested probability.
sourceMethod: Follows the official same-bin geometric-series calculation and symmetry argument. Makes independence, mutual exclusivity, and series convergence explicit.

review.mathCheck: Independently, P(red>k)=Σ(j>k)2^(-j)=2^(-k). Conditioning on the green bin therefore gives P(red>green)=Σ(k≥1)4^(-k)=1/3, choice C. The candidate's tie probability 1/3 and symmetry argument give the same result.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded expansion of MAA 10B solution 17 on page 7: sum same-bin probabilities, take the complement, and divide equally between the two orders.
review.annotationCheck: The explanation explicitly establishes independence, disjoint tie events, geometric convergence and color symmetry. Assessed and supporting roles are coherent.
